content.text: The licence grant meets the preferred position in every material respect.

input.quote:
13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 13 meets the preferred position on all material terms. The subscription grant in 13.1 expressly extends to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (no notice condition needed), and to Authorized Users; the paid-up grant in 13.2 is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, including contractor support rights. Clause 13.3 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24 — and § 24.1 allows assignment to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent, with § 24.4 barring Vendor from terminating, repricing or suspending on our change of control. Revocation or suspension is limited to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity, so the licence is not revocable at will. The "Affiliate" definition (§ 1.1) is standard >50% control and is adequate. No redline required.
